subject: general
question: In which of the following years was the state of Golconda finally annexed into the Mughal empire?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1687**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The state of **Golconda** was annexed into the **Mughal Empire** in the year **1687** by Emperor **Aurangzeb**.
 
• Golconda was a prominent kingdom in the **Deccan region of India**, known for its **forts, diamond mines, and prosperity.**
 
• Aurangzeb launched an **extensive military campaign** against Golconda due to its strategic importance and economic wealth.
 
• The siege of **Golconda Fort** was a significant event during the annexation. The fort was renowned for its **strong defenses** and was considered one of the most impregnable forts in India.
 
• After a prolonged siege, the Mughal forces succeeded in capturing Golconda, marking the end of its independence.
 
• The annexation of Golconda strengthened the **Mughal Empire’s control over the Deccan region**, consolidating its dominance in South India.
 
• Golconda was also famous for its **Koh-i-Noor diamond**, which later became a part of the Mughal treasury.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **1697**__

 __
 
• This date does not correspond to the annexation of Golconda. By **1697**, the Mughal Empire had already established its dominance in the Deccan.
 
 
 
• **1685**__
 __
 
• The year **1685** marked the beginning of Aurangzeb's intensified campaigns in the Deccan region, but Golconda was annexed later in **1687**.
 
 
 
• **1690**__
 
 
• **1690** is not relevant to the annexation of Golconda, as by this time the Mughal Empire was focused on consolidating its territories rather than expanding further into the Deccan.
